working_dev: Software engineer who uses the product or a competitor at work; engages when a post shows something they can use today.
early_adopter: Tries every new dev tool the week it ships; reposts launches with a clear demo or a number that matters.
skeptical_senior: Staff engineer who distrusts marketing copy; replies to sharp, specific, true claims and ignores vague hype.
tech_media: Newsletter writer or aggregator covering developer tools; amplifies news, big partnerships and surprising results.
